blocks.text: AI SEO agent that researches, writes, and publishes content automatically

Fonzy is an AI SEO agent that handles the entire content pipeline from keyword research to publication. Most startups know they need consistent SEO content but lack the bandwidth to produce it - Fonzy eliminates that bottleneck by researching your market, writing optimized articles, sourcing images, adding internal links, and publishing directly to WordPress, Shopify, or Webflow, all without manual intervention.

The content quality is the differentiating factor. Fonzy uses a multi-stage agentic workflow that conducts competitor analysis, clusters keywords by topic, and generates articles structured to rank in both Google and AI search engines like ChatGPT and Perplexity. Support for 25+ languages means international growth strategies are equally accessible from day one.

For agencies managing multiple clients, Fonzy's white-label reporting and API access make it a viable platform to deliver SEO content at scale without growing your team. The Starter plan handles roughly 30 articles per month, while the Agency tier supports custom volume - giving you room to scale without switching tools.
Multi-stage agentic workflow that researches, writes, and edits SEO-optimized articles
Publishes directly to WordPress, Shopify, and Webflow with images and internal links included
Automated keyword strategy and competitor analysis tailored to your market
Content structured to rank in Google and AI-powered search engines like ChatGPT and Perplexity
Earns backlinks from relevant editorial sources to strengthen domain authority
Custom-branded reports for agencies managing multiple client accounts

The biggest SEO bottleneck for startups is content volume, not strategy. Fonzy solves the execution side by automating the research and writing pipeline, so you maintain a consistent publishing cadence without adding headcount.
Our team can integrate Fonzy into your workflow and automate the repetitive parts.
